critique: Exceptional industrial design and editorial photography. The vertical rectangular monolith housing, 9 upper radial tick marks with a completely blank bottom arc, single burnt-orange pointer hand per dial, and label layout are completely faithful to the reference. The wet engawa wood texture and out-of-focus moss garden create a serene, magazine-grade Japanese architectural atmosphere.
prompt_fix: None required; minor micro-detail on the question mark in 'WORTH IT?' could be sharper at extreme zoom, but overall it passes all criteria at a very high level.
